description: Na₄TeO₅ is High Pressure (4-7GPa) Tellurium-derived structured and crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. There are five inequivalent Na¹⁺ sites. In the first Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to six O²⁻ atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent TeO₆ octahedra, corners with four NaO₆ octahedra, edges with three equivalent TeO₆ octahedra, and edges with nine NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 3-22°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.55 Å. In the second Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to six O²⁻ atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with three NaO₆ octahedra, corners with three equivalent TeO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent TeO₆ octahedra, and edges with ten NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 3-21°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.68 Å. In the third Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to six O²⁻ atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six NaO₆ octahedra, edges with three equivalent TeO₆ octahedra, and edges with nine NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 18-22°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.48 Å. In the fourth Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to six O²⁻ atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent TeO₆ octahedra, corners with four NaO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent TeO₆ octahedra, and edges with ten NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 4-19°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.78 Å. In the fifth Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to six O²⁻ atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six NaO₆ octahedra, edges with four equivalent TeO₆ octahedra, and edges with eight NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 17-20°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.35 Å. Te⁶⁺ is bonded to six O²⁻ atoms to form TeO₆ octahedra that share corners with six NaO₆ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one TeO₆ octahedra, and edges with eleven NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 3-15°. There are a spread of Te-O bond distances ranging from 1.90-2.08 Å. There are five inequivalent O²⁻ sites. In the first O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded to five Na¹⁺ and one Te⁶⁺ atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₅Te octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-18°. In the second O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded to five Na¹⁺ and one Te⁶⁺ atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₅Te octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-18°. In the third O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded to five Na¹⁺ and one Te⁶⁺ atom to form distorted ONa₅Te octahedra that share corners with five ONa₅Te octahedra and edges with nine ONa₄Te₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-14°. In the fourth O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded to four Na¹⁺ and two equivalent Te⁶⁺ atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₄Te₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-14°. In the fifth O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na¹⁺ and one Te⁶⁺ atom.
